dimensions.assessment: Affects NASA, state and local governments, nonprofit educational or scientific corporations, and institutions of higher education entering into lease arrangements.
dimensions.evidence: The Administrator of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration... may... lease... real property under the jurisdiction of the Administrator to 1 or more entities described in subsection (c)

dimensions.assessment: Enables long-term leases and leaseback agreements for specific properties to facilitate space research and training, yielding administrative and operational adjustments rather than nationwide life-changing impacts.
dimensions.evidence: lease, for a term not to exceed 50 years, real property under the jurisdiction of the Administrator to 1 or more entities described in subsection (c) for the purpose of the construction and operation... of 1 or more facilities

dimensions.assessment: Involves the expenditure or receipt of revenues from lease and leaseback arrangements, subject to the availability of appropriations, but states no specific broad federal spending amounts.
dimensions.evidence: Subject to the availability of appropriations, the Administrator may--(1) enter into 1 or more agreements... to lease back real property described in subsection (a)

dimensions.assessment: Provides specific supplemental leasing and support authorities to NASA while carving out exceptions from certain existing federal property management statutes.
dimensions.evidence: The authority provided by this section shall apply--(1) regardless of the existing authority used by the Administrator to lease the real property... and (2) notwithstanding [specified statutes]

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes long-term leases for up to 50 years with renewal options and establishes permanent annual reporting requirements for NASA.
dimensions.evidence: lease, for a term not to exceed 50 years, real property under the jurisdiction of the Administrator... The Administrator may renew a lease under this subsection for 1 or more additional periods.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill provides NASA with supplemental lease authority for real property to support research and education with state, local, and educational entities, generating administrative effects and annual congressional reporting.
